deadline.value: Final Ph.D. application deadline is December 15 for non-U.S. citizens (recommended October 30) and March 1 for U.S. citizens (recommended January 1; University Fellowships deadline January 15).
deadline.quote: Deadlines | Ph.D.: Recommended January 1 (US citizens). Final deadline is March 1 (US citizens). | Ph.D.: Recommended October 30 (Non-US citizens), final deadline December 15 (Non-US citizens).

gre_general.value: The GRE General Test is not required for Ph.D. applicants, though submitted scores are added to the file for consideration.
gre_general.quote: The GRE and/or subject tests are not required for Ph.D. and Thesis M.S. applicants; however, if submitted, the results are added to the applicant's file for consideration.

gre_subject.value: ETS discontinued the Biology GRE Subject Test; the department does not require subject tests.
gre_subject.quote: The GRE and/or subject tests are not required for Ph.D. and Thesis M.S. applicants; however, if submitted, the results are added to the applicant's file for consideration.

also.quote: The GRE Subject Tests in Mathematics, Physics and Psychology measure undergraduate achievement in a particular field of study

supervisor.value: Students may enter either having chosen a major professor or complete first-semester laboratory rotations before selecting a major professor.
supervisor.quote: You can enter the Ph.D. program either having chosen a major professor, or you can choose to do a series of laboratory rotations in your first semester to become acquainted with various research possibilities.

funding.value: Fellowships and teaching assistantships are available on a competitive basis (University Fellowships deadline January 15; Fellowship/Teaching Assistantship deadline March 15).
funding.quote: Note: Fall semester deadline to be considered for a Fellowship or Teaching Assistant ship is March 15. University Fellowships deadline is January 15.

entry_route.value: Applicants must hold a baccalaureate degree from an accredited institution and complete 90 credit hours for the Ph.D.
entry_route.quote: To be eligible for graduate admission to the biology department, you must hold a baccalaureate degree from an accredited institution of higher learning and demonstrate good preparation in biology, organic chemistry, physics, and mathematics.

also.quote: The Doctor of Philosophy in Biology requires 90 credit hours and is the highest degree conferred in the Department of Biology at IU Indianapolis.
